final: WITH pa AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type='PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type='VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_amt, AVG(t.balance) AS avg_bal FROM trans t JOIN account a ON a.account_id=t.account_id JOIN district d ON d.district_id=a.district_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), r AS (SELECT region, AVG(avg_amt) AS region_avg_amt, AVG(avg_bal) AS region_avg_bal FROM pa GROUP BY region), m AS (SELECT AVG(region_avg_amt) AS overall FROM r) SELECT r.region, r.region_avg_amt, r.region_avg_bal, r.region_avg_amt / m.overall AS ratio FROM r, m WHERE m.overall IS NOT NULL
